verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs mention agents that turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities, and SCA scanning surfaces findings directly in merge requests, which implies automated remediation MRs for vulnerable dependencies. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dependency-update bot (like Dependabot) or concrete example of an auto-generated MR bumping a vulnerable dependency version. Missing for 10: explicit description of automated dependency-update MR workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation that such MRs are auto-created and merged.
